WITH per_operator AS (
  SELECT crewref,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count,
         AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY crewref
),
operator_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg
  FROM per_operator
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT p.scan_count,
         p.avg_gb_per_minute,
         b.all_operator_avg
  FROM per_operator p
  CROSS JOIN operator_baseline b
  WHERE p.avg_gb_per_minute > b.all_operator_avg
)
SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS avg_number_of_scans,
       AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
       AVG(avg_gb_per_minute - all_operator_avg) AS avg_margin_above_all_operator_avg
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Only scans with both file size and a nonzero duration contribute to each operator’s average GB per minute; operators with no such scans are excluded from the operator baseline and comparison.
